title: Irish Potato Bowl
description: A simple and delicious dish featuring boiled Irish potatoes, topped with a flavorful mix of herbs and spices. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Place the chopped potatoes in a large pot and add enough cold water to cover them.
Bring the water to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Drain the potatoes and return them to the pot. Add the chopped parsley and ground black pepper.
Toss the potatoes to combine with the herbs and spices.
Serve the potatoes hot in individual bowls.
